summary: Iteration 2: Tested NEW Admin Dashboard + bulk actions per review request. Backend: 19/19 pytest passed (dashboard permissions 403 for manager/member, 401 without header; summary/team-summary/attention-items content correctness; bulk-update admin & member; bulk-delete admin & permission blocks; member bulk cannot set Closed). Frontend: Playwright verified sidebar (Dashboard link admin-only, hidden for manager/member; manager /dashboard shows admin-only notice), all metric cards + 5 status tiles + team table + attention panel render, View Work Sheet link navigates; bulk actions: checkboxes, select-all, bulk-status apply to Closed (2 rows update, selection clears), bulk-delete (2 rows removed), member bulk status dropdown correctly excludes Closed/Changes Requested, delete button hidden for manager AND member.

minor.issue: When a member includes an id belonging to another member in the batch, scoped_update_fields raises 403 mid-loop which aborts the whole request (any rows processed before the offending id remain updated, subsequent ones untouched). Spec expected: skip the offending row and continue. Consider wrapping per-item logic in try/except and returning partial success list.

action_items: Spec vs implementation mismatch: review request states 'As Admin/Manager, also a Delete selected button should be visible' but BulkActionBar only renders delete for admin. Backend /api/work-items/bulk-delete uses require_admin, so hiding for manager is consistent with backend. Decide which is authoritative - if managers should be allowed to bulk-delete, update backend to allow manager role and update UI; otherwise the review-request wording should be corrected. Current UI is safe/aligned with backend.
(Minor) Make bulk-update tolerant to per-row permission failures instead of raising 403 that aborts the entire batch (see backend_issues.minor).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py bulk_update_work_items: if scoped_update_fields raises 403 for one id, previously-updated ids in the loop are already persisted causing partial writes with a 403 status returned - non-atomic and confusing. Wrap per-item block in try/except HTTPException and return {updated: [...], errors: [...]} for clearer contract.
server.py dashboard_summary/team_summary/attention_items iterate full collection in Python; fine for MVP but consider MongoDB aggregation pipelines once data grows.
Sidebar.jsx: uses hardcoded color `#0c2b30`; consider a theme token for consistency.
BulkActionBar delete-btn visibility check `currentUser.role === 'admin'` is fine but should ideally derive from a permissions helper to stay in sync with backend.
test_credentials: None. X-User-Id header. Seeded ids: admin-1, manager-1, manager-2, member-1, member-2, member-3.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed rows and clean them up. Note: frontend bulk-delete test permanently removed 2 rows from the pre-existing dataset (rows went 9 -> 7 as admin). Not restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suites: /app/backend/tests/test_worksheet.py (20 tests, CRUD/perms) and /app/backend/tests/test_dashboard_and_bulk.py (19 tests, dashboard + bulk). Run both: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. All dashboard endpoints require admin (require_admin). Bulk delete is admin-only in backend AND UI. Bulk update currently aborts on first permission-violating id — flagged as minor. Frontend uses localStorage 'acting_user_id' for role switching.
